title: Scaling a Web App
subtitle: A ladder of bottlenecks, where each rung adds one building block
motto: Add the next block only when the last one breaks
coreAddition: load balancer, cache and read replicas
keyInsight: Each building block moves the bottleneck instead of removing it, so add the next one only when the current one saturates.

decisions.title: Model stages 2 to 5 of the ladder, not all ten
decisions.description: The sim covers the load balancer, cache and read replicas, where the numbers are concrete and one variable (the database load) tells the story.
decisions.alternatives: Simulating all ten stages, including sharding and multi-region, would need many invented parameters and bury the idea that each block moves the bottleneck.

decisions.title: Use the note's ballpark capacities and prices
decisions.description: An app server at 1,000 req/s and a database at 5,000 queries/s, with monthly prices, keep the numbers traceable to the vault.
decisions.alternatives: Round abstract units would be simpler but would not let learners compare the cost of each rung with real budgets.
